translations.pt: Estou com muita sede Tenho chorado até secar desde o dia em que fui enxovalhado

transcript.pronunciation_roman: My ex walked away , leaving me with a broken heart I let the drinking start

translations.ja: 元恋人にフラれてボロボロの心にされたから、やけ酒を始めるよ
translations.en: My ex walked away, leaving me with a broken heart I let the drinking start
translations.ko: 전 애인은 떠나고, 상처받은 내 마음만 남겨두고 술을 마시기 시작했지
translations.zh-TW: 我的前任一走了之，留給我一顆破碎的心 我開始酗酒
translations.id: Mantan kekasihku pergi, meninggalkanku dengan hati yang patah Aku mulai minum-minum
translations.pt: Meu ex foi embora, deixando-me com o coração partido Deixei a bebedeira começar

transcript.text: I knew you would drag me all the way here Every time you’re jilted you just drink a bad beer You drink a year in a day and get drunk belligerently Flirty love, dirty love, what would you do differently?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アイ・ニュー・ユー・ウッド・ドラッグ・ミー・オール・ザ・ウェイ・ヒア・エヴリ・タイム・ユーア・ジルテッド・ユー・ジャスト・ドリンク・ア・バッド・ビール

translations.ja: 君がこうやって僕をここに引きずり込むのは分かってたよ。フラれるたびにまずいビールばかり飲んで
translations.en: I knew you would drag me all the way here Every time you’re jilted you just drink a bad beer You drink a year in a day and get drunk belligerently Flirty love, dirty love, what would you do differently?
translations.ko: 네가 날 여기까지 끌고 올 줄 알았어 너 차일 때마다 맛없는 맥주만 마시잖아 하루 만에 일 년 치를 마시고 꼻아박지 장난스러운 사랑, 지저분한 사랑, 넌 다르게 어떻게 하겠어?
translations.zh-TW: 我知道你會把我一路拖來這裡 每次你被甩就只會喝爛啤酒 你一天之內喝掉一年的份，醉得不可理喻 調情的愛、骯髒的愛，你到底能有什麼不同？
translations.id: Aku tahu kau akan menyeretku sampai ke sini Setiap kali kamu dicampakkan, kamu hanya minum bir murahan Kamu minum jatah setahun dalam sehari dan mabuk sejadi-jadinya Cinta genit, cinta kotor, apa yang akan kau lakukan secara berbeda?
translations.pt: Eu sabia que você me arrastaria até aqui Toda vez que leva um fora, você toma uma cerveja ruim Você bebe o equivalente a um ano em um dia e fica furiosamente bêbado Amor flertante, amor sujo, o que você faria diferente?

transcript.text: First glass is always for the sake of the day Second one is for driving tears away Third, fourth, fifth with nothing else good to say
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ファースト・グラス・イズ・オールウェイズ・フォー・ザ・セイク・オブ・ザ・デイ・セカンド・ワン・イズ・フォー・ドライヴィング・ティアーズ・アウェイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: First glass is always for the sake of the day Second one is for driving tears away Third , fourth , fifth with nothing else good to say

translations.ja: 最初の1杯は今日一日のため、2杯目は涙を追い払うため
translations.en: First glass is always for the sake of the day Second one is for driving tears away Third, fourth, fifth with nothing else good to say
translations.ko: 첫잔은 언제나 오늘 하루를 위해 두 번째 잔은 눈물을 날려버리기 위해 세 번째, 네 번째, 다섯 번째는 할 말도 없으면서
translations.zh-TW: 第一杯總是為了這一天 第二杯是為了趕走淚水 第三、第四、第五杯，沒什麼好話好說
translations.id: Gelas pertama selalu demi hari ini Yang kedua untuk mengusir air mata Yang ketiga, keempat, kelima tanpa ada hal baik lain yang bisa dikatakan
translations.pt: O primeiro copo é sempre em homenagem ao dia O segundo é para afastar as lágrimas Terceiro, quarto, quinto sem mais nada de bom a dizer

transcript.text: You yowl that your liver wants to come out and play Thinking that drinking could end this feeling
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ユー・ヨウル・ザット・ユア・リヴァー・ワント・トウ・カム・アウト・アンド・プレイ・シンキング・ザット・ドリンキング・クッド・エンド・ディス・フィーリング
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You yowl that your liver wants to come out and play Thinking that drinking could end this feeling

translations.ja: 肝臓が飛び出して遊びたがってるって叫んで、お酒を飲めばこの気持ちが終わるなんて考えてるんだ
translations.en: You yowl that your liver wants to come out and play Thinking that drinking could end this feeling
translations.ko: 간이 튀어나와서 놀고 싶다고 울부짖지 술을 마시면 이 감정이 끝날 거라 생각하며
translations.zh-TW: 你哭喊著說你的肝想出來玩 以為喝酒能結束這種感覺
translations.id: Kamu meraung bahwa hatimu ingin keluar dan bermain Berpikir bahwa minum bisa mengakhiri perasaan ini
translations.pt: Você berra que seu fígado quer sair para brincar Achando que beber poderia acabar com esse sentimento

transcript.text: Clinging to the bottle, you’re like a ship sinking Saloons close down on you but then you ask for more Platoons can’t hold you back because you’re drunk to the core
transcript.pronunciation_kana: クリング・トゥ・ザ・ボトル、ユーア・ライク・ア・シップ・シンキング・サロングス・クローズ・ダウン・オン・ユー・バット・ゼン・ユー・アスク・フォー・モア

translations.ja: ボトルにしがみついて、まるで沈没する船みたいだね。バーが閉まってもさらに注文するんだから
translations.en: Clinging to the bottle, you’re like a ship sinking Saloons close down on you but then you ask for more Platoons can’t hold you back because you’re drunk to the core
translations.ko: 병에 매달려, 넌 가라앉는 배 같아 술집은 문을 닫는데 넌 더 달라고 하네 뼛속까지 취해서 누구도 널 말릴 수 없어
translations.zh-TW: 緊抱著酒瓶，你就像一艘下沉的船 酒館打烊了你卻還要求再來 誰也擋不住你，因為你已經爛醉如泥
translations.id: Berpegangan pada botol, kamu seperti kapal yang tenggelam Kedai minum tutup untukmu tapi kemudian kamu minta lagi Pasukan tak bisa menahanmu karena kamu sudah mabuk parah
translations.pt: Apegado à garrafa, você é como um navio afundando Os bares fecham para você, mas aí você pede mais Pelotões não conseguem te segurar porque você está bêbado até a alma

translations.pt: Deixei a bebedeira começar, mas minha garganta ainda está seca Estou com muita sede (lá vamos nós de novo) Só mais um copo para me fazer sentir bem

translations.pt: Depois desta rodada, quero começar do zero Gole, gole (chega!) Outra rodada, gole, gole (chega!) Outra rodada, mais um! (Eu disse, chega!)

transcript.text: You always drink like hell is calling You always drink ‘til the sky is falling Making a mess left and right, it’s appalling
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ユー・オールウェイズ・ドリンク・ライク・ヘル・イズ・カリング・ユー・オールウェイズ・ドリンク・ティル・ザ・スカイ・イズ・フォーリング
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You always drink like hell is calling You always drink ‘til the sky is falling Making a mess left and right , it ’s appalling

translations.ja: まるで地獄が呼んでいるみたいに飲むし、空が落ちてくるまで飲み続けるんだから
translations.en: You always drink like hell is calling You always drink ‘til the sky is falling Making a mess left and right, it’s appalling
translations.ko: 넌 늘 지옥이 부르는 것처럼 마셔 하늘이 무너질 때까지 마시지 양옆으로 사고를 치고, 끔찍할 정도로
translations.zh-TW: 你總是喝得像地獄在呼喚 你總是喝到天崩地裂 把事情搞得一團糟，實在是慘不忍睹
translations.id: Kamu selalu minum seperti neraka memanggil Kamu selalu minum sampai langit runtuh Membuat kekacauan ke sana ke mari, sungguh memualkan
translations.pt: Você sempre bebe como se o inferno estivesse chamando Você sempre bebe até o céu desabar Fazendo uma bagunça para todo lado, é horrível

transcript.text: Losing finesse high and low, it’s galling You’re wasted like a AE86 gets badly drifted Drink after drink after drink like you’re gifted
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ロージング・フィネス・ハイ・アンド・ロウ、イツ・ガリング・ユーア・ワステッド・ライク・ア・エーイーハチロク・ゲッツ・バッド・ドリフテッド
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Losing finesse high and low , it ’s galling You ’re wasted like a AE 86 gets badly drifted Drink after drink after drink like you ’re gifted

translations.en: Losing finesse high and low, it’s galling You’re wasted like a AE86 gets badly drifted Drink after drink after drink like you’re gifted

translations.pt: Perdendo a compostura em cima e embaixo, é irritante Você está destruído como um AE86 que derrapou feio Gole após gole após gole como se tivesse dom

transcript.text: Others drink a retail, but you go a wholesale  Soaking up the bar, there’s nothing left to resell I’m not here to trace each step, I’m not your rep

translations.en: Others drink a retail, but you go a wholesale  Soaking up the bar, there’s nothing left to resell I’m not here to trace each step, I’m not your rep

translations.zh-TW: 別人喝的是零售，你卻是批發 把酒吧喝個精光，沒剩什麼好轉賣 我不是來追蹤你的每一步，我也不是你的代表
translations.id: Orang lain minum eceran, tapi kamu grosiran Membasahi bar, tidak ada lagi yang tersisa untuk dijual kembali Aku di sini bukan untuk melacak setiap langkahmu, aku bukan perwakilanmu
translations.pt: Outros compram a varejo, mas você compra no atacado Encharcando o bar, não sobrou nada para revender Não estou aqui para seguir cada passo seu, não sou seu representante
